description: Add up to 50 links at once, from links or from pasted text: one link per line (a title before or after it, or [title](url)), or spreadsheet rows with a url or link column and optional title, section, code and note columns (cells pasted from Excel or Google Sheets work, or an uploaded CSV or XLSX file as media_id, such as bio_export's CSV). A line without a link names the link under it; above two or more links it's a section title. Links without a title are named by their own pages, with their pictures. Links already on the page, repeats and rows without a link are skipped and listed. Try dry_run first with a long or messy list; undo takes the whole batch off.

dry_run.description: Say what would be added and skipped, changing nothing

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

auto_apply.description: Its short link applies the code at checkout (Shopify stores only)

percent_off.description: What the code takes off, in percent: the page says "20% off"

section.description: A section title to put it under: an existing one, or a new one made for it

media_id.description: An uploaded CSV or XLSX file (media_upload_url), instead of links; the first sheet is read

on_bio.description: Show them on the bio page

position.description: Where links without a section go: top, bottom (the default), { after: link_id } or { under_section: link_id }

skip_rows.description: Rows to leave out, by the row numbers a dry run lists (for a spreadsheet or pasted text; the rows of links count from 1)

text.description: A pasted list or spreadsheet text, instead of links

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: links_add
title: Add many links
